ShaderNodePreset.Description: Use to control how saturated highlights shift hue as they blow out to white - e.g. blues going cyan or skin going lemon-yellow. A late, tone-map-stage highlight fix.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: BB_PathToWhite

Uniform.Tooltip: Input image
Uniform.Name: front

Uniform.Tooltip: Select input color space for correct luminance and gamma handling
Uniform.Name: colorSpace

Uniform.Tooltip: Brightness at which the path-to-white shaping is centered. Lower = affects more of the image. Values above 1.0 target HDR highlights in Scene-Linear / ACEScg.
Uniform.Name: pivot

Uniform.Tooltip: Softness / width of the transition into the highlights
Uniform.Name: rolloff

Uniform.Tooltip: Hue-band width in degrees. Narrow = distinct bands, wide = smooth continuous blend between hues.
Uniform.Name: hueFalloff

Uniform.Tooltip: Master strength of the hue steer and saturation shaping
Uniform.Name: strength

Uniform.Tooltip: Pull residual chroma toward clean white in the highlights (0 = keep color, 1 = full desaturation to white)
Uniform.Name: pathDesat

Uniform.Tooltip: Keep original luminance - apply only the hue/saturation shaping, no brightness change
Uniform.Name: preserveLuma

Uniform.Tooltip: Result, or view the highlight mask to dial Pivot / Rolloff
Uniform.Name: outputMode

Uniform.Tooltip: Rotate red hue in the highlights (counter red-to-yellow skew)
Uniform.Name: steerRed

Uniform.Tooltip: Hold (+) or drop (-) red saturation on the path to white
Uniform.Name: satRed

Uniform.Tooltip: Rotate green hue in the highlights
Uniform.Name: steerGreen

Uniform.Tooltip: Hold (+) or drop (-) green saturation on the path to white
Uniform.Name: satGreen

Uniform.Tooltip: Rotate blue hue in the highlights (counter blue-to-cyan skew)
Uniform.Name: steerBlue

Uniform.Tooltip: Hold (+) or drop (-) blue saturation on the path to white
Uniform.Name: satBlue

Uniform.Tooltip: Rotate cyan hue in the highlights
Uniform.Name: steerCyan

Uniform.Tooltip: Hold (+) or drop (-) cyan saturation on the path to white
Uniform.Name: satCyan

Uniform.Tooltip: Rotate magenta hue in the highlights (counter magenta breakup)
Uniform.Name: steerMagenta

Uniform.Tooltip: Hold (+) or drop (-) magenta saturation on the path to white
Uniform.Name: satMagenta

Uniform.Tooltip: Rotate yellow hue in the highlights
Uniform.Name: steerYellow

Uniform.Tooltip: Hold (+) or drop (-) yellow saturation on the path to white
Uniform.Name: satYellow
